texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: I’m working on a startup idea and it got me thinking—what are the types of business models out there? Are there any creative ways to design our business model?
texts.text: Q: I’m working on a startup idea and it got me thinking—what are the types of business models out there? Are there any creative ways to design our business model?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: When I saw your question, I went looking for a quick answer. I was sure there would be a bunch of blog posts or HBR articles that succinctly summarize all of the ways you can make money as a business. I was wrong. There was nothing out there. So I’ve gone ahead and taken a shot at coming up with an answer. Below, you’ll find:
